notes: Supplemental high-level public-spending sources that are intentionally kept separate from the 66 basic-council registry. verified=true means the official disclosure surface was manually checked; it does not imply row ingestion is implemented.

sources.note: Official Seoul Open Data dataset; exposes department, use datetime, merchant/place, payment method, amount, purpose, target and budget item. API access requires a Seoul Open Data authentication key, so ingestion should support API-key and file-download modes.

Official Gyeonggi disclosure pages. Governor and department-level monthly pages plus a quarterly headquarters board should be normalized into the same event schema while retaining actor/department lineage.
Official Incheon information-disclosure portal. Separate boards expose mayor, vice-mayor and headquarters director-level business-promotion expenses with downloadable PDF attachments.

Do not treat parliamentary/political-fund spending as directly comparable with local-government business-promotion expenses. Register only an official disclosure source that exposes merchant-level expenditure with sufficient purpose/date/amount lineage; otherwise keep this cohort disabled from publication.
